instruction: Load the unpacked extension located in the helloExtension folder on your Desktop into Chrome, and ensure it is enabled after installation.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires loading unpacked Chrome extension from Desktop and verifying it is enabled (state=1). Custom getter reads Chrome preferences to find the extension by path and extracts its enabled status. Metric checks if the extension is enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts extension enabled status by reading Chrome Preferences file and matching the exact extension path (/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dict directly (expected.get('enabled')) without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules')
Complete coverage: Both requirements verified (extension loaded from correct path AND enabled status)
Expected value semantically correct: enabled=true matches instruction requirement 'ensure it is enabled'
Data flow is correct: Getter returns {'enabled': bool} -> Metric receives rules {'enabled': true} -> Comparison works properly
Edge cases handled: Extension not found, disabled, or Preferences file errors all return enabled=False, causing metric to correctly return 0.0
No state timing issues: Chrome persists extension state in Preferences file immediately, so reading after task completion is reliable
